selected_route_elapsed_prediction.evidence: The base curve is the fresh forced-SIMD minimal observable store-only kernel sweep at physical grids 1,2,4,8,16,32,56. The global-load residual is the median direct-copy profiler duration minus its compiler-derived route resource and the base boundary at P=1: 314.207 SYS_CNT for forced SIMD and 485.789 SYS_CNT for selected SIMT. Independent P=4/P=56 direct-copy controls confirm the term is a sub-microsecond completion envelope rather than a per-operation slope. Kernel argument count is reported for diagnosis only: the v105 held-out set disproved an additive argument-count charge because two four-argument kernels with different structural work required opposite corrections. The prologue/epilogue fields are an equal accounting split, not separately measured components.
selected_route_elapsed_prediction.formula: (kernel_boundary_residual_system_cycles(candidate, superblock_factor, runtime_physical_program_count) + has_global_load * global_load_boundary_residual_system_cycles(route) + runtime_argument_setup_system_cycles(route, kernel_argument_count) + route_resource_system_cycles) / system_counter_frequency_mhz

1.grid_stride_resident_memory_evidence: Fresh explicit-SIMT factor1 sweep on healthy A5 card3 at total direct FP32 footprints 3, 6, 12, 24, 48 and 96 MiB. The 3-48 MiB points form one steady resident regime; 96 MiB is held out on the existing rotating/cold rates. Independent 2-load/1-store and 4-load/1-store bodies identify load/store rates without an operator name, kernel name, or exact-shape condition. Source grid-stride F1/F2/F4 controls execute the same serialized source body and therefore share this resource curve; no pipeline overlap is modeled.
